_comment: Experiment 1 (docs/battle_feasibility.md): one fake battle in the battle finder. Read on every request, so edits apply without a restart. variant 'probe' = connect to target_probe (UDP logger in listen_server.py), 'localmap' = CleanLoad a local map, 'listen' = join a client hosting the map with ?listen (target_listen; the host registers each joining player from /dev/battle/members/, team listen_team, battle character IDs from first_member_id). The client builds 'CleanLoad <address>:<port>?credential=...', so the localmap address ends with a dummy option that swallows ':<port>'.
name: LocalTest
